system.description:
Trigger: As part of making a melee attack

When you score a hit with a melee attack, you can use this surge to suddenly bite down, or grab an enemy in such a way that you have them held down. The affected creature becomes Grappled and you immediately can move up to twice your full speed pulling them along with you. While grappled in this way the affected creature cannot take reactions. Once you’ve finished this movement, you end the grapple on the affected creature.
